import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, '.codex/skills/docx')
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked')
editor = doc['word/document.xml']

# Print all top-level paragraphs with their style and text
paras = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName('w:p')
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    # Get style
    style = ''
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName('w:pPr')
    if pPr:
        pStyle = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName('w:pStyle')
        if pStyle:
            style = pStyle[0].getAttribute('w:val')
    # Get text
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:t'):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.data if t.firstChild else '')
    for dt in p.getElementsByTagName('w:delText'):
        texts.append('[DEL:' + (dt.firstChild.data if dt.firstChild else '') + ']')
    text = ''.join(texts)
    print(f'{i:3d} | style={style:15s} | {text[:120]}')

from defusedxml import minidom

print(f'Total paragraphs: {len(paras)}')

    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName('w:pPr')
    if pPr:
        pStyle = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName('w:pStyle')
        if pStyle:
            style = pStyle[0].getAttribute('w:val')
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:t'):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.data if t.firstChild else '')
    for dt in p.getElementsByTagName('w:delText'):
        texts.append('[DEL:' + (dt.firstChild.data if dt.firstChild else '') + ']')
    text = ''.join(texts)
    print(f'{i:3d} | style={style:15s} | {text[:130]}')

print('---')
# Show last 3 top-level children of body
children = [c for c in body.childNodes if c.nodeType == c.ELEMENT_NODE]
print(f'Body top-level element children: {len(children)}')
for c in children[-5:]:
    print(c.tagName)

from defusedxml import minidom

dom = minidom.parse('unpacked/word/document.xml')
root = dom.documentElement
print('Root tag:', root.tagName)
print('Namespaces:')

# check settings.xml for trackRevisions
try:
    sdom = minidom.parse('unpacked/word/settings.xml')
    print('settings.xml trackRevisions:', len(sdom.getElementsByTagName('w:trackRevisions')))
except Exception as e:
    print('settings.xml error:', e)
